notes.title: Demo Update №3
notes.notes: [p][b]The following improvements and bug fixes have been made:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slightly improved parkour system. It should now be easier to grab onto things (I'll continue to work on this);[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly improved camera behavior;[/p][/*][*][p]The game has been updated to have deeper gamepad support. Icons, menus, and so on will work with a gamepad if you play with it;[/p][/*][*][p]QTE was not displayed during the cat stage if a gamepad was connected to the PC[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the performance of music zones. Transitions sometimes occurred when they shouldn't have;[/p][/*][*][p]Final fix for a bug that sometimes caused not all letters to appear in animated text;[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Iguana's ability to pull the player with its tongue;[/p][/*][*][p]You can hide behind obstacles from the Iguana's tongue;[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse Vision power recovery time was 30 seconds. Now 20;[/p][/*][*][p]If you take a stone, when it is highlighted by the power of Mouse Vision, it will shine endlessly;[/p][/*][*][p]Running takes less energy;[/p][/*][*][p]Edible grains sometimes did not disappear after being eaten;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some buggy flowers and bushes in Introduce Mode;[/p][/*][*][p]In Introduce Mode, after death, a checkpoint from Story Mode was loaded;[/p][/*][*][p]After loading a checkpoint, you could get to the cat's house if you completed the storyline there. This should not have happened - fixed;[/p][/*][*][p]A checkpoint preserves the location of objects that was moved;[/p][/*][*][p]Added some sound details to the location;[/p][/*][*][p]An action icon will appear above the item when you can actually pick it up;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with mice that give items. Sometimes they would disappear before the player could find them;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the energy interface. When drinking coffee, a visual effect should have been applied to it (if you had full energy);[/p][/*][*][p]Many graphical elements have been updated, both in the game itself and in the main menu;[/p][/*][*][p]Increased plant rendering distance;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the main character model on medium and lower settings;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hats and other customization items hanging in the air in cutscenes;[/p][/*][*][p]Customization items now show up in cutscenes;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the combat system. You could hold down W + LMB and fight endlessly;[/p][/*][*][p]And many other small fixes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for your interest in the game![/p][p][b]If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review on Steam. It helps me a lot![/b][/p][p]                                                [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42168125/c3bb3a1d838e3241ea3dcf10b32aa0e323e693fe.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the music for the cat scene would continue to play after the scene ended;[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly improved the cat's vision;[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being awarded for a new storyline.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]I'm continuing to improve the demo. Thank you for your interest in the game![/p]

Thanks for your interest in the game![/p]
